Definition: to rest (as at home); causatively (through the implied idea of beauty), to celebrate (with praises)
BiblicalUsage: At the Red Sea Moses sings that he will beautify his God and prepare Him a dwelling, and Habakkuk says the proud man does not rest at home but enlarges his desire like the grave.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that beauty and rest belong together: the heart that adorns God finds its home in Him, while the proud heart never rests and never has enough.
